title: Touching craft pieces with Garry Nolan

tellings.quote: Like I've seen pieces of a craft. I've been with Garry Nolan. I don't know if they're real pieces of a craft, but like they seem.

plain: Michels says he has seen pieces said to come from a craft, in the company of the scientist Garry Nolan, who studies such material. He tells it himself as something he was present for, adding that he does not know if they are "real pieces of a craft, but like they seem," which, if they were, would mean physical remains of an unknown vehicle exist to be examined.
